subject: gk
question: Which statement about Classical Carnatic Music is correct?

options.text: The compositions are either in Malayalam, Marathi, Tamil or Bengali.
The compositions are either in Marathi, Odia, Konkani or Bengali.
The compositions are either in Telugu, Malayalam, Hindi or Sanskrit.
The compositions are either in Telugu, Kannada, Tamil or Sanskrit.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The compositions are either in Telugu, Kannada, Tamil or Sanskrit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The compositions in Classical Carnatic Music are either in **Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, or Sanskrit.**
 
• Carnatic music, known for its intricate and complex compositions, primarily uses these languages for its lyrics and vocal performances.
 
• These languages have a rich history and are deeply embedded in the cultural and musical traditions of South India.
 
• The compositions often reflect religious themes, devotional content, and classical poetry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carnatic music** is a major system of Indian classical music that originated in the southern part of India.
 
• It is known for its fixed compositions and a high degree of improvisation within the structure of the raga (melodic framework) and tala (rhythmic cycles).
 
• The compositions are usually set to a specific raga and tala, and are performed with a high level of technical proficiency and emotional expression.
 
• Some of the most renowned composers in Carnatic music include **Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar, and Syama Sastri.**
